name: @droidagentkit/launcher
description: Android development MCP server: Gradle, adb, logcat, lint, crash triage, Perfetto, emulator control. Thin Node launcher for the DroidAgentKit JVM MCP server — locates the `droidagent` CLI (or a fetched archive), verifies its SHA-256, and spawns `droidagent serve-mcp --transport stdio`. Node is an install-time dependency only; the server runtime is pure JVM.
